physical_axi_beat_counts.burst_range_note: AXI AW/AR are bounded length<=16 by q8_axi_monitor; actual burst splitting is measured, not assumed. Minimum requests if every contiguous region uses full16 bursts: read1186, write209; maximum is one request per beat. R/W beat bytes are exact for legal full-word accesses.

schedule_basis.report_loop_708_per_tile_cycles: 23..1294 per legal tile/g iteration; 4096 concrete iterations gives at most 5300224 serialized schedule cycles before any external stalls, using this per-iteration ceiling only, not the report's unconstrained dynamic whole-loop maximum
schedule_basis.conditional_unstalled_core: 135 selected FSM states plus eight 42-cycle dot child calls imply 471 cycles between adjacent same-g tile issue edges; 4096 vectors contribute 1929216 core cycles. Trace-on adds 32*12=384 non-wait state samples. This omits between-g work, LOAD, quant, output/report, AXI wait and control overhead; it is neither a measured issue interval nor a full-run cycle forecast.
schedule_basis.report_loop_705_tile_clear: C++ loop 705 iterates T=128 tiles and loop 706 clears 32 lane_bad entries per tile; report 66 cycles per tile gives 128*66=8448 nominal cycles for one m0 block, plus entry/exit. The g-loop is 707 and its actual boundary overhead remains unmeasured.
schedule_basis.report_loop_762_output: at most 463 cycles per tile in report, 128 tiles = 59264 nominal cycles plus entry/exit
schedule_basis.scalar_validation: 32768 scale elements then 1024 bias elements; FSM state116/160 first/last and visit counts are measured, with no ACT MAC-ratio scaling
schedule_basis.load_transport: 16384 q beats, 1024 scale beats, 1056 aux 32-bit beats, plus descriptor128 and observed256; bounded legal adapter delays and response drain are measured separately

guards_proposed.source_reason: 4096*1294=5300224 is a conditional legal issue/retire path ceiling, not a full-run bound. The scale validation inner loop alone is 53*32768=1736704 clocks, before outer, transport, control, quant/trace, output/report and AXI waits. The unchanged 7000000/16000000 limits are fail-stop watchdog proposals, not WCET or runtime approval.
guards_proposed.progress_record_note: The TB flushes a passive progress.log record at command start and every 131072 command clocks; records expose actual simulator progress without extending watchdogs or predicting completion.
guards_proposed.wall_basis: Prior ACT suite 38302 clocks/14.376505s and other modes 15951/9.473611s, 79971/21.229002s include startup and small-page behavior. At a deliberately slower 500 clocks/s, 16M guard is 32000s plus setup/raw checks; 36000s is a finite first-pilot runtime allowance, not a predicted completion time.

policy: one Laya heavy tool, at most four CPUs, nice19, idle I/O, owned RSS every0.2s, MemAvailable strictly>192GiB; stop and seal first unexpected guard, protocol or numerical result
conditional_next_step: After the first three commands seal, fit actual per-stage clocks, simulator rate and RSS. Do not release later rows/families/faults from this budget.
